scientific_integrity.new_statement: Exact characterization of bases with infinitely many prime generalized Brier coefficients and uniform consecutive-prime strings, by a unit-residue refinement of a published two-sided construction.
scientific_integrity.reliance: Virbalas 2026 dual coverings; prime number theorem for fixed reduced progressions; Shiu and Maynard consecutive-prime results.

scientific_limitations: The covering systems and two-distinct-prime-factor property used as an input are from Virbalas (2026), not reproved or claimed new.
The known base-two consecutive-prime Brier phenomenon is credited to Filaseta, Juillerat and Luckner (2022/2023).
The result is nonconstructive as to small prime examples and gives no optimized progression modulus.
Exceptional single prime candidates in excluded bases are not separately classified.
title: Prime generalized Brier numbers: an exact base dichotomy and consecutive-prime strings
